title: Something I did this week
setting: A quiet room, just Chris talking to a friend who asked how his week was. This is a model of the speaking diagnostic: 30 seconds to prepare, then about 45 seconds of ordinary talk. Not a speech.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay, so, this week was pretty normal, I guess.
lines.spoken: Okay, so, this week was pretty normal, I guess.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I worked a lot, which is not that interesting.
lines.spoken: I worked a lot, which is not that interesting.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: But, um, on Wednesday I actually cooked, which I don't do that much.
lines.spoken: But, um, on Wednesday I actually cooked, which I don't do that much.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I made pasta, like, a really simple pasta, and I called Maya and I was like, you wanna come over, I made too much.
lines.spoken: I made pasta, like, a really simple pasta, and I called Maya and I was like, you wanna come over, I made too much.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: And she came over, and we just sat there and talked for a long time, and it was... it was nice.
lines.spoken: And she came over, and we just sat there and talked for a long time, and it was... it was nice.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I needed a night that wasn't just me and my laptop.
lines.spoken: I needed a night that wasn't just me and my laptop.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Friday I was gonna go out, but I was tired, so we kinda canceled, or we moved it, I don't remember.
lines.spoken: Friday I was gonna go out, but I was tired, so we kinda canceled, or we moved it, I dunno.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Anyway. That's been my week. Not exciting, but not bad.
lines.spoken: Anyway. That's been my week. Not exciting, but not bad.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: If I had to pick one thing, it was the pasta night. That's the thing I'm glad I did.
lines.spoken: If I had to pick one thing, it was the pasta night. That's the thing I'm glad I did.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Even if the pasta was just okay.
lines.spoken: Even if the pasta was just okay.

gist.askZh: 他觉得这周怎么样？哪件事让他比较高兴？
gist.askEn: How does he feel about the week, and what is he glad he did?

details.askZh: 他是哪天做饭的？为什么叫 Maya？
details.askEn: Which day did he cook, and why did he call Maya?

details.askZh: 周五原来的计划怎么样了？

glue.span: I was like, you wanna come over
glue.hear: I was like, you wanna come over
glue.noteZh: I was like 用来转述自己当时的话，不是‘我喜欢’。后面的 wanna come over 要整块听。
glue.standard: I was like, you want to come over

glue.span: we kinda canceled, or we moved it
glue.hear: we kinda canceled, or we moved it
glue.noteZh: kinda 夹在中间，or 表示他自己也记不清是取消还是改期，口语里这种含糊很常见。
glue.standard: we kind of canceled, or we moved it

glue.span: that wasn't just me and my laptop
glue.hear: that wasn't just me and my laptop
glue.noteZh: wasn't just 里的 t 很弱，just 是‘仅仅’。整句是‘我需要一个不只是对着电脑的晚上’。
glue.standard: that was not just me and my laptop

roleplay.setupZh: 一个刚认识的人随口问：‘最近怎么样 / 这周都干什么了？’用平常的口气讲一件小事就行，不必精彩，也不要背稿。卡住时可以说：Hang on, what's the word… I mean…
roleplay.aiRole: A friendly acquaintance who asked how your week was. Listen more than you interrogate. If the learner freezes, offer two simple starters, wait, and do not correct grammar mid-sentence.
variants: The learner talks about a meal out.
The learner talks about a trip to a store or a short walk.
The learner only has a work day to describe, and that's fine.
starters: Okay, so, this week was pretty normal.
The one thing I did was…
Hang on, what's the word… I mean…

fluency.promptZh: 准备 30 秒，然后用大约 45 秒讲一件这周做过的事，哪怕很小。不要正式，不要追求精彩。如果脑子空白，先说 This week was pretty normal，再补一个细节。说完以后，如果愿意，可以用同一件事再做一遍 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Take 30 seconds to prepare, then speak for about 45 seconds about one thing you did this week, even a small one. Don't make a speech. If you go blank, start with 'This week was pretty normal' and add one detail. After that, you can optionally do the same story in 60, 45, then 30 seconds.
